process: A man is painting the word victory in large black letters on a weathered concrete wall, one letter at a time from left to right.

stages.state: Vict painted, crossbar of t in progress
stages.prompt: A man with dark curly hair and a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Large black brush-painted letters read Vict: a bold V, a dotted i, a curved c, and a t whose crossbar he is painting with a loaded brush. Paint drips run down from the letters.

A man with dark curly hair and a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Large black brush-painted letters read Victo: a bold V, a dotted i, a curved c, a finished t, and a rounded o just painted to its right. He holds the brush in his raised hand. Paint drips run from the letters.

A man with dark curly hair and a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Large black brush-painted letters read Victor, with the new r painted to the right of the o. He has stepped slightly right and holds the brush against the wall. Paint drips run from the letters.

A man with dark curly hair and a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Large black brush-painted letters read Victor, and the first stroke of the y is being painted to the right of the r. He is at the right edge of the lettering. Paint drips run from the letters.

stages.state: Victory nearly done, y being finished
stages.prompt: A man with dark curly hair and a dark grey long-sleeved shirt stands with his back to the camera, painting on a weathered grey concrete wall. Large black brush-painted letters now read Victory, with the y nearly complete and its tail extended downward. His brush touches the wall just below the final stroke. Paint drips run from the letters.
